description: The motor neurons of his six legs, pool by pool, as the dataset names them. Facts only: which neurons, which leg, which side. What each muscle does to a leg comes from papers and lives in the movement mapping, not here. Front-leg pools gate the census because the ceremony's handling is done with the front legs.

evidence.claim: Bound by its annotated type name, Acc. ti flexor MN, with superclass vnc_motor and subclass fl (front leg, soma in neuromere T1). The name states the muscle the dataset's annotators assigned it to. What that muscle does to the leg is not claimed here.

notes.title: Named only in the front leg
notes.text: Tarsus levator and depressor and the tergopleural promotor carry a muscle name only in the front leg. In the middle and hind legs the corresponding neurons, if traced, are among the serially named ones.

notes.title: Their transmitter hardly matters here
notes.text: Fly motor neurons release glutamate at the muscle. Their transmitter label matters only for the few synapses they make inside the cord.

inventory.caption: Every neuron of superclass vnc_motor, by subclass and type. fl, ml and hl are the legs; the rest drive the wings, halteres, neck and abdomen.
